_what_this_is: Pre-tune measurements for the polish pass. Every number here is a BEFORE value: what the build does today, so a later change can be judged against it rather than against memory.
_authority: Docs/canon/FEEL.md. The windows below are owned by that file; this file only records measurements against them.
_status: SEEDED EMPTY. No value in this file has been measured. Null means not measured, and the gate reports MISSING -- not PASS -- until a human fills it in.
_how_to_measure_traversal: 1. Open Content/HomeWorld/Maps/VS_MVP/L_VS_MVP_Markers.umap in the DESKTOP editor. Cells must be streamed; a nullrhi commandlet cannot time a walk.
2. Use the eight-verb script in Docs/qa/POLISH_HUMAN_PLAYTEST.json as the run order, so the timings come from a comparable route each time.
3. cabin_to_lookout_s: spawn at the cabin PlayerStart, walk the CRUMB_ path to CRUMB_Lookout, stop the timer on arrival. Three runs; record the median.
4. island_circuit_s: cabin -> lookout -> path stones -> back to cabin, the same loop the canon window describes.
5. Write the median to measured_s. Do not record a number you did not time.
_how_to_measure_tunables: Each tunable below currently has no measured value. Record the value the build uses TODAY, before any tuning.
Read the live value out of the editor or log -- do not copy the proposed range out of FEEL.md. The proposal is the destination, not the baseline.
Record strings for enum-ish choices, numbers for numeric ones. A null here is an open question, and leaving it null is a valid, honest answer.

cabin_to_lookout_s.note: Median of three timed walks. Empty until a human times it. Deferred to the polish pass by Lead decision 2026-10-04 - see _deferrals.

island_circuit_s.note: Full circuit. Empty until a human times it. Deferred to the polish pass by Lead decision 2026-10-04 - see _deferrals.

_tunables_what_this_is: BEFORE values, measured 2026-10-04 from Source/HomeWorld and Config. NOT chosen values - every proposal in FEEL.md is still open and none of these numbers endorses it. Each entry carries the file and line it was read from, because _waiver_policy says a plausible value must be distinguishable from a real one later, and a bare number cannot be.
_tunables_how_these_were_read: Static read of source; no editor was running, so anything a Blueprint or console could override at runtime is recorded as a confidence caveat rather than as certainty. 'confidence: high' means a C++ default or CVar default with no .ini override found and no override found in any .uasset name table. Per docs/KNOWN_ERRORS.md, absence of a string in a name table is not proof of absence - but a Blueprint storing a property override must reference the property name, so absence is stronger evidence here than in the general case.

glide_gravity_scale.value: no such parameter in the build
glide_gravity_scale.source: Source/HomeWorld/HomeWorldFallbackGlideComponent.h:54 (GlideDurationSeconds = 32.0f, ClampMin 25.0 ClampMax 40.0); HomeWorldFallbackGlideComponent.cpp AdvanceGlide reads no gravity term
glide_gravity_scale.note: FALLBACK glide is spline interpolation over CRUMB_GlideSpline with a duration, not a physics arc. FEEL.md's 0.35-0.55x-gravity proposal has nothing to scale. To make it tunable someone has to add a property first. Baseline for the decision: the knob does not exist.

glide_lateral_influence.source: Source/HomeWorld/HomeWorldFallbackGlideComponent.cpp - no BindAction, no AddMovementInput, no steer path in the component
glide_lateral_influence.note: Read as 0 because the component never reads player input while gliding, which matches canon 'FALLBACK = no free steer'. Medium not high: I read the component, not every input path that could reach the character mid-glide. Confirm in-engine before treating it as settled.

camera_arm_length_uu.source: Source/HomeWorld/HomeWorldCharacter.h:399 - UPROPERTY(EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin 100.0, ClampMax 2000.0) float TargetArmLength = 400.0f; assigned at HomeWorldCharacter.cpp:198
camera_arm_length_uu.note: EditDefaultsOnly, so a Blueprint subclass could override it. None found: 'TargetArmLength' appears in 0 .uasset name tables. Also UE's own USpringArmComponent default is 400, so the C++ author may have set it to match rather than to choose. Already inside the proposed 350-500 range.

camera_pitch_bias_deg.value: no bias parameter in the build; camera pitch follows controller rotation through the spring arm
camera_pitch_bias_deg.source: no PitchBias / PitchMin / PitchMax anywhere in Source/HomeWorld (162 files); HomeWorldCharacter.cpp:195-198 creates the spring arm with no rotation offset
camera_pitch_bias_deg.note: Weakest of the six. This is absence of an identifier, which is weaker evidence than absence of a parameter I actually read - see _how_these_were_read. Verify in-engine before treating 0 as the baseline.

night_length_s.source: Source/HomeWorld/HomeWorldTimeOfDaySubsystem.cpp:47-49 - CVar hw.TimeOfDay.NightDurationSeconds, default 120.f; read at line 161 when SetPhase(Night) runs
night_length_s.note: A console variable, so it is runtime-overridable and this is the compiled default, not a guarantee about a play session. No .ini sets it. Inside the proposed 90-180 s window.

gather_cooldown_s.source: Source/HomeWorld/HomeWorldResourcePile.h:43 - UPROPERTY(EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin 0.0) float HarvestCooldownSeconds = 0.f; line 39 - bool bDepleteUntilDawn = true
gather_cooldown_s.note: Records which branch FEEL.md asked for: the implemented policy is deplete-until-dawn with a zero-second cooldown, not a 60-120 s timer. So half of that proposal is already decided in code and the open question is only whether dawn-depletion stays. 'HarvestCooldownSeconds' appears in 0 .uasset name tables. This is NOT a recommendation to keep it.

_deferrals._what_this_is: Decisions to leave a row unmeasured on purpose, with the reasoning and the condition that would reverse it. A deferred row and an abandoned row are otherwise indistinguishable in the gate output, and only one of them has somebody waiting on it.

traversal_measured.reasoning: The island the traversal would be timed on is not the island in the build. The .blend and the export manifest said 180 x 100 m while Unreal was still holding a 19.3 x 10.7 m .uasset imported on 2026-09-28, so a circuit time recorded today would describe the wrong island and would later be cited as if it described the right one. Close the engine gap first, then time the walk.
traversal_measured.reversed_when: env.ue_island_measured stops reading MISSING. Sequencing: re-import the FBX, re-place the actor, measure, commit - and only then walk the routes.
traversal_measured.not_a_waiver: env.traversal_measured is still MISSING and still holds G-ENV RED. Deferring is not excusing. The row keeps reporting, and the gate keeps refusing to call the world ready to tune.

_tunable_notes.glide_gravity_scale: FEEL.md proposes 0.35-0.55x default gravity while on the FALLBACK spline. Read the live value from HomeWorldFallbackGlideComponent.
_tunable_notes.glide_lateral_influence: FEEL.md proposes 0 if FALLBACK is cinematic, else <=15% of corridor width. Canon says FALLBACK = no free steer, so the expected reading may well be 0.
_tunable_notes.camera_arm_length_uu: FEEL.md proposes 350-500 UU. Read from the SpringArm on BP_HomeWorldCharacter.
_tunable_notes.camera_pitch_bias_deg: FEEL.md proposes -8 to -15 degrees. Read from the controller or the SpringArm relative rotation.
_tunable_notes.night_length_s: FEEL.md proposes 90-180 s real time before the rest prompt. See Docs/DAYNIGHT_BIBLE.md.
_tunable_notes.gather_cooldown_s: FEEL.md proposes until dawn OR 60-120 s, matching the SYS 'deplete until dawn' preference. Record which branch is actually implemented.

_waiver_policy: Do not write a number here to make a gate go green. A null that is honestly null is worth more than a plausible value, because a plausible value cannot be told apart from a real one later.
